qa.overall_assessment: All success criteria verified via Playwright browser testing on the live deployed site. Each category renders as a single horizontal scroll row with uniform 280x320px cards (desktop) and 240x300px cards (mobile). Horizontal scrolling works, click-to-expand detail sidebar preserved, Timeline view unaffected. Both generators updated consistently.

success_criteria_results.criterion: Every category section renders items in a single horizontal row (no wrapping)
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Playwright browser_evaluate: checked display:flex, flex-wrap:nowrap on all .category-scroll-container elements at desktop (1280px) and mobile (375px) viewports
success_criteria_results.details: All 5 category containers (meals, attractions, entertainment, shopping, accommodation) use display:flex with flex-wrap:nowrap. No wrapping observed in screenshots.
evidence: Desktop screenshot qa-desktop-meals-row.png shows meals in single horizontal row
Desktop screenshot qa-desktop-shopping-accom.png shows shopping and accommodation in horizontal rows
Mobile screenshot qa-mobile-375.png shows single-row layout on 375px viewport

success_criteria_results.criterion: Horizontal scrollbar appears when items overflow viewport width
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Playwright browser_evaluate: checked overflow-x:auto and scrollWidth > clientWidth on containers with multiple cards
success_criteria_results.details: Meals container (9 cards): scrollWidth=2256, clientWidth=328 (mobile) - scrollable=true. Attractions (4 cards): scrollable=true at both viewports. Entertainment (2 cards): scrollable at mobile, not at desktop (fits). Shopping (3 cards): scrollable at mobile, fits at desktop.
evidence: Container 0 (meals): scrollWidth 2256 > clientWidth 328 at mobile viewport
Visible scrollbar in qa-desktop-meals-row.png below meals row

success_criteria_results.criterion: All cards within each category have identical width and height
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Playwright browser_evaluate: measured getBoundingClientRect() on all cards in each container at both desktop (1280px) and mobile (375px) viewports
success_criteria_results.details: Desktop: All cards 280x320px uniformly across meals, attractions, entertainment, shopping, accommodation. Mobile: All cards 240x300px uniformly. Transportation card uses height:auto (180px measured) as documented - intentional design decision since it has no image.
evidence: Mobile measurements: [{w:240,h:300},{w:240,h:300}] for all containers except transportation (240x180)

success_criteria_results.criterion: Cards maintain consistent visual design across categories
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Visual inspection of screenshots and accessibility tree analysis at both viewports
success_criteria_results.details: All cards follow the same template: image area on top (140px desktop / 120px mobile), category label with color coding, title with ellipsis truncation, time/cost/type/location info, 2-line clamped description. Each category has its own accent color (meals=#e67e22, attractions=#3498db, entertainment=#9b59b6, shopping=#e74c3c, accommodation=#27ae60).
evidence: Screenshots qa-desktop-meals-row.png and qa-desktop-shopping-accom.png show consistent card structure
Accessibility tree confirms uniform structure: image > category label > title > details > description

success_criteria_results.criterion: Layout works on both desktop and mobile viewports
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Playwright browser_resize to test 1280x900 (desktop) and 375x812 (mobile/iPhone) viewports with card dimension measurement
success_criteria_results.details: Desktop (1280px): cards 280x320px, responsive breakpoint correctly detected as non-sm. Mobile (375px): cards 240x300px, responsive breakpoint correctly detected as sm. Both viewports render horizontal scroll containers correctly.
evidence: Card dimensions verified programmatically at both viewports

success_criteria_results.criterion: Both generators (interactive React and bucket-list HTML) updated consistently
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Code review of both files: generate-html-interactive.py (inline React styles) and html_generator.py (CSS classes)
success_criteria_results.details: Interactive generator uses inline flex styles (display:flex, flexWrap:nowrap, overflowX:auto) with 280x320/240x300 card dimensions. html_generator.py .activity-grid CSS changed from grid to flex with nowrap, overflow-x:auto, scroll-snap. .activity-card has min-width:280px, width:280px, flex-shrink:0. Both use scroll-snap-type:x proximity and thin scrollbar styling.
evidence: generate-html-interactive.py lines 2192-2199: scrollContainerStyle with flex nowrap
html_generator.py lines 1319-1357: .activity-grid flex layout, .activity-card fixed 280px width

root_cause_verification.rationale: This is a design change request, not a bug fix. The original grid layout with auto-fill/auto-fit wrapping and the 2-column attractions layout have been completely replaced with flex nowrap horizontal scroll containers. Each category now has its own full-width section with uniform cards. The 2-column grid (gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr') has been removed. All categories use the same card template.

build_verification.deploy_command: Included in generate-and-deploy.sh (copies to /var/www/travel/ and pushes to GitHub Pages)
build_verification.build_output_summary: HTML generated successfully (387212 bytes), deployed to local server and GitHub Pages

regression_test_results.details: Switched to Timeline View via Kanban/Timeline toggle button. Full timeline with all events (transportation, meals, attractions, accommodation) rendered correctly with proper time slots and click handlers.

Clicked on meal card (Tianxingju restaurant). Detail sidebar appeared with full information: title, time, cost, cuisine, signature dishes, location link, notes. Close button (X) works. onItemClick handler preserved.
Clicked May 4 (Mon) in sidebar to navigate to Datong day. Page updated correctly with Datong content including all categories (meals, attractions, accommodation, transportation, budget).
Map links (Gaode) open correctly in new tabs. Verified via accessibility tree that all location links have proper amap.com URLs.
Budget section with donut chart and category breakdown renders correctly. Not converted to horizontal scroll (intentional - documented in dev report).
